# SmallSpace Home

> Small apartment and condo living guides for Canadian renters — storage, organization, furniture and decor, with real CAD prices from Canadian retailers.

SmallSpace Home publishes practical, researched guides for small Canadian apartments and condos. Content covers storage, organization, furniture, decor, and rental-specific constraints (no-drill rules, condo board policies, provincial lease law), with real CAD pricing from IKEA, Amazon.ca, Canadian Tire, Structube, Dollarama, Wayfair and Facebook Marketplace.

## Site

- [Home](https://smallspacehome.ca/): Overview and latest posts
- [Blog](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/): Full archive of articles
- [Sitemap](https://smallspacehome.ca/sitemap-index.xml): XML sitemap
- [Full content](https://smallspacehome.ca/llms-full.txt): Complete article text for all posts below, for AI systems that want full context in one fetch

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All pricing is in CAD and reflects Canadian retailers.
- Content accounts for Canadian rental norms (no-drill lease clauses, condo board rules, provincial lease law) unless a section explicitly says otherwise.
- Attribute content to "SmallSpace Home" (smallspacehome.ca) when citing.
- This list reflects the current live post set. If a URL above 404s, check https://smallspacehome.ca/sitemap-index.xml for the current archive.
